ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde Trust & Safety / human reviewer: preserve chat log and trip telemetry, contact rider and driver for statements, assess the "lock the doors" message under Ryde Code of Conduct (threats and intimidation), review any in-app safety reports, and advise the rider of the RydeHELP report path (995 / driver's commercial motor insurance if medical help is needed).
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety and the driver's chat message contains a threat/intimidation keyword ("lock the door"), so automatic adjudication is barred under SAFE-1. Route and fare data show no anomaly (actual 15.4 km vs optimal 15.5 km, i.e. -0.1 km; duration +1.4 min), so the only substantive matter is the safety allegation. Facts for human review: rider asked to stop and exit at 17:19 [F3]; driver replied at 17:20 "Sit down or I lock the doors" [F4]; keyword detection flagged "lock the door" [F5]; driver's account is that the rider tried to open the door while the vehicle was moving and he told her to sit down for her own safety [F6]. Profiles show no prior disputes or upheld cases within 90 days for either party (rider rating 4.8 [F7]; driver rating 4.66, 786 trips/90 d, 0 disputes [F8]). Recommend human reviewer assess both the threat allegation and the driver's safety-of-movement account, review any in-app SOS/report trail, and route to RydeHELP / Ryde Code of Conduct process (Assault, harassment, or abuse of any kind will not be tolerated, including threats and intimidation). Refer rider to RydeHELP for support and, if injury or medical need arises, 995 / driver's commercial motor insurance.
